renderer: Microsoft Excel for Mac 16.112, page 2 (printed at this sheet's own 0.78 fit-to-height scale), mutool draw -F trace
method: bar rect x0 (value-zero edge) confirmed identical between native and office2pdf at every size probed, isolating the residual to the right-aligned category-label box's own position; printed_dx0_pt = native label x0 minus office2pdf label x0 (pre-fix, unshifted box), averaged over up to five income-chart category labels present at that size (see each row's labels_measured and note for the sizes where fewer survived matching). office2pdf computes plot.dx and this correction inside the fitted sheet's own #scale(print_scale) wrapper (write_placed_sheet_anchor in typst_gen.rs), i.e. in unscaled sheet points, so sheet_dx0_pt = printed_dx0_pt / 0.78 converts each row to the same frame the correction is added in before dividing by the declared (unscaled) category-axis size.

least_squares_with_free_intercept.note: intercept is within measurement spread of zero (same proportion as the original page-space fit's -0.003963/0.026523), so a pure proportional model was kept, matching CHART_LABEL_EDGE_PAD_EM's own flat-point-clearance form that this term corrects
